content: WordPress page builders detectable via HTML class prefixes: Divi uses et_pb_ prefixed classes (et_pb_section, et_pb_module); WPBakery uses vc_row, vc_column, wpb_wrapper classes plus meta generator tag 'WPBakery Page Builder' and asset paths containing /js_composer/; Elementor and Oxygen leave distinctive HTML comments and asset paths (/oxygen/). WordPress's body_class() function itself emits theme/builder-related classes on <body>, making body class inspection a reliable signal source.
